section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1980
title: 22 Volume of suicides in States, Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities : The volume of suicides per lakh of population for India as a whole was 6.28 and for the States, Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities it was 6.26, 7.20 and 7.48 respectively. The volume of suicides per lakh of population for the states as a whole (6.26) was slightly less than the all-India average of (6.28) and for the Union Territories (7.2) and for Metropolitan Cities (7.48) was more than the all-India average of (6.28). Among the States, the highest volume of suicides was recorded in Karnataka (16.37) followed by Tripura (15.55), Kerala (14.86), West Bengal (12.79), Tamil Nadu (10.25), Assam (8.80), and Orissa (8.75). All these States recorded more volume of suicides than the all-India average of (6.28). All the remaining States recorded less volume than the all-India average, the lowest being Jammu. & Kashmir (0.56) followed by Bihar (0.63) and Manipur (0.84). Among the Union Territories, the highest volume of suicides was recorded in Pondicherry (37.95) followed by Andaman & Nicobar Islands (24.59) and the lowest in Mizoram (1.35) followed by Chandigarh (2.02) and Arunachal Pradesh (2.88). Among the Metropolitan Cities Bangalore recorded the highest number of cases (936) with a volume of 45.88 suicides per lakh of population while it was the lowest (23) cases with a volume of (0.68) in Calcutta. The details are presented in Table-II.
